descriptions.w3d_d26e_read_records_802029b8: Reads the record table of a chunk reader: resizes the 64-byte record vector at +124 to the count at +84 (vector erase with an empty copy loop and a destroy loop, or fill insert), reads count*64 bytes through stream virtual slot 5 and byte-swaps fields a, b, c and d of each record. Field names are inferred from the original instructions.
